findings.evidenceJa: 視界が[ruby text=にご]濁る
findings.governingReading: my vision clouds over
findings.explanation: Obscured vision becomes instability.

findings.highlight: It hurts every time I take a step
findings.evidenceJa: 坂道を下りる度に肩が痛んで
findings.governingReading: my shoulder hurts with every step down the slope
findings.explanation: The downhill trigger for Shirou’s pain disappears.

findings.highlight: It should be hard for you even to walk
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎、歩くのも辛いでしょう
findings.governingReading: Shirou, even walking must hurt
findings.explanation: Rin’s shift into personal name address is omitted.

findings.highlight: we should get Tohsaka back to her home ground
findings.evidenceJa: 少しでも早く遠坂を自分のホームグラウンドに戻すべきだ
findings.governingReading: I should get Tohsaka back onto her own home ground as quickly as possible
findings.explanation: Shirou’s urgency disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 怒鳴ってくる
findings.governingReading: she shouts at me
findings.explanation: The force of Rin’s loss of composure is reduced to ordinary scolding.

findings.evidenceJa: のっぴきならない事態
findings.governingReading: an unavoidable, critical situation
findings.explanation: The severity and inescapability of the church crisis are generalized.

findings.highlight: It’s more painful for you, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の方が辛いだろう
findings.governingReading: you are the one who is hurting more, Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition of Rin’s emotional pain becomes an unnatural comparison.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分の家、自分だけの部屋
findings.governingReading: her own house, her room that belongs to her alone
findings.explanation: The two layers of privacy Shirou wants to restore to Rin collapse into one location.

findings.highlight: walks over to the grassy area
findings.evidenceJa: ずんずんと草むらまで歩いていく
findings.governingReading: strides forcefully over to the grass
findings.explanation: Rin’s embarrassed, forceful gait disappears.

findings.highlight: I hear a sound behind me
findings.evidenceJa: とさん、と背後で音がした
findings.governingReading: a soft thump sounds behind me
findings.explanation: The exact seated impact cue becomes generic sound.

findings.evidenceJa: 黒こげの空
findings.governingReading: the charred-black sky
findings.explanation: The fire-scarred image tying the sky to Shirou’s interior world is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: 黙り込んでいたお隣さん
findings.governingReading: my silent neighbor
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lightly comic reference to Rin beside him is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: きっと弱音だった
findings.governingReading: it was surely an admission of weakness
findings.explanation: Rin’s rare vulnerable confession is labeled peevish whining.

findings.highlight: wants someone else to make her do it
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かに反省させてほしかった
findings.governingReading: wanted someone else present while she reflected
findings.explanation: Rin’s wish not to face regret alone becomes a wish for coercion by another person.

findings.highlight: I was talking to him earlier
findings.evidenceJa: ついさっきあんなコト言ったのに
findings.governingReading: even though I said all that just a moment ago
findings.explanation: Rin refers to her own recent declaration, not merely a conversation with Archer.

findings.evidenceJa: 何にってつっこむところ
findings.governingReading: where you retort “cornered by what?”
findings.explanation: The working setup of Rin’s comic prompt is generalized away.

findings.highlight: I’m even more depressed that I’ve made a mistake
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎があんな事いうから、余計失敗したなー、って落ち込んじゃった
findings.governingReading: because you said that, Shirou, I got even more depressed thinking I had failed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s role in prompting Rin’s self-doubt disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺にはおまえが眩しい
findings.governingReading: you are dazzling to me
findings.explanation: A present, personal admission becomes a claim about Rin’s entire past.

findings.highlight: make all the tragedies that happened into meaningful things
findings.evidenceJa: 悲劇を、無意味なものにしたくない
findings.governingReading: do not want all the tragedies that occurred to become meaningless
findings.explanation: Refusing meaninglessness is strengthened into positively assigning meaning to tragedy.

findings.evidenceJa: きっとその倍は仕返しをするタイプ
findings.governingReading: the type who will retaliate twice over
findings.explanation: The scale of Rin’s comic retaliation disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 鬼が[ruby text=かくらん char=2]霍乱しているうちに
findings.governingReading: while even the ogre is suffering a rare illness
findings.explanation: Shirou’s proverb-based joke about formidable Rin being unusually weak is replaced by tactical opportunism.

findings.evidenceJa: 微笑がこぼれた気がした
findings.governingReading: I felt as though a smile escaped her as she recovered herself
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative perception is promoted into fact.

findings.highlight: must have said everything she wanted to
findings.evidenceJa: 言いたい事は言ったのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps having said what she wanted
findings.explanation: A tentative explanation for Rin’s silence becomes necessity.

findings.highlight: neither one of us can stand up to break the moment
findings.evidenceJa: どちらも立ち上がれずに
findings.governingReading: neither of us can get up
findings.explanation: The English supplies an emotional purpose for their immobility that the source leaves unstated.

findings.evidenceJa: どうしても何もない
findings.governingReading: there is no particular “why” to it
findings.explanation: Shirou’s claim that the answer is self-evident becomes inability to explain.

findings.evidenceJa: ランサーに殺されかけた時
findings.governingReading: when Lancer nearly killed me
findings.explanation: A near-fatal attack is stated as Shirou’s completed death.

findings.highlight: as if she’s heard something she shouldn’t have
findings.evidenceJa: 見てはいけない物を見たように
findings.governingReading: as though she had seen something she must not see
findings.explanation: The sensory image and taboo relation are both changed.

findings.evidenceJa: 悪い気はまったくしなかった
findings.governingReading: I did not feel bad at all
findings.explanation: The narrator’s unqualified pleasure gains unsupported self-alienation.

findings.evidenceJa: よっ、なんて元気のいい声をだして
findings.governingReading: with an energetic “heave-ho,” Rin pulls me up
findings.explanation: Rin’s lively vocal effort disappears.
